# City and County of Broomfield, CO

> Official municipal website for Broomfield, Colorado providing resident services, civic engagement, emergency alerts, and community resources.

Broomfield is a city and county in Colorado offering integrated municipal services through its official website. The site uses CivicPlus and CivicEngage platforms to deliver government information, emergency notifications, utility services, and community programs to residents.

## Key Topics

- Emergency Alerts & Public Safety
- Water Conservation & Drought Management
- City Council & Civic Engagement
- Residential Services
- Employment & Economic Development
- Parks & Recreation
- Utilities & Billing
- Capital Improvements
- Community Programs
- Motor Vehicle Services
- Broomfield Police Department
- Public Works
- Fire Alerts & Bans
- Waste Management
- Fiber-to-Home Infrastructure

## Emergency Alerts & Public Safety

- [Alert Center](https://broomfield.org/AlertCenter.aspx): Emergency alerts and public safety notifications for Broomfield residents
- [News Flash](https://broomfield.org/CivicAlerts.aspx): City news alerts and civic announcements for Broomfield residents
- [Police Department Community Academy](https://broomfield.org/1340/BPD-Inside-Academy): Broomfield Police Department community education program registration

## Civic Engagement & Government

- [Engage](https://broomfield.org/3812/Engage): Civic engagement, City Council meetings, and government transparency
- [Calendar](https://broomfield.org/calendar.aspx): City Council meetings and municipal events calendar

## Resident Services & Utilities

- [Live](https://broomfield.org/3809/Live): Guide to living in Broomfield with city services and resident resources
- [Pay Your Bill](https://broomfield.org/2348/Pay-Your-Bill): Online payment portal for water, property tax, and licensing bills
- [Residential Waste Services](https://www.broomfield.org/3980): Trash and recycling service information with enrollment details
- [Water Use and Drought Restrictions](https://broomfield.org/4249/Water-Use-and-Drought-Restrictions/WaterUseandDroughtRestrictions): Water conservation ordinances and drought restriction guidelines
- [Water Conservation](https://broomfield.org/3107/Water-Efficiency): Water conservation programs, rebates, and efficiency tips for residents
- [Fiber-to-Home Installation](https://broomfield.org/4359/Fiber-to-Home-Installation): Fiber network installation and utility permitting process information

## Employment & Economic Development

- [Work](https://broomfield.org/3810/Work): Employment, business licensing, and economic development resources
- [Employment Opportunities](https://broomfield.org/2401/Employment): City government job postings and career opportunities

## Recreation, Parks & Community

- [Explore](https://broomfield.org/3811/Explore): Parks, trails, recreation programs, and community amenities in Broomfield
- [2026 Summer Program Guide](https://www.broomfield.org/ProgramGuide): Summer recreation classes and community program registration guide

## Infrastructure & Planning

- [Capital Improvement Program](https://www.broomfield.org/213/Capital-Improvements-Program): Infrastructure planning and 5-year capital improvement project details

## Motor Vehicle & County Services

- [Motor Vehicle](https://www.broomfield.org/284/Motor-Vehicle): Vehicle registration, titles, and DMV services in Broomfield County

## Optional

- [Eat Local Restaurant Guide](https://broomfield.org/4050/Eat-Local-Restaurant-Guide): Interactive map of locally-owned restaurants and dining establishments
